title: Los Alamos working group concludes UFOs are interdimensional
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

plain: A guest named Jay Anderson, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says a man named Oke Shannon told him about a working group at Los Alamos National Laboratory, a US government research lab in New Mexico, sometime in the 2000s. According to Anderson, the group concluded that UFOs are interdimensional objects coming down into a lower dimensional plane, an idea he links to Flatland, a story about beings who live in only two dimensions. If true, it would mean government scientists believed the objects come from beyond our ordinary space.
